source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 (ISLB A1) · lesson 12. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: Purification before prayer, step by step (11 steps)

learn.en: The Prophet ﷺ said prayer is not accepted without purity. So before praying, we make wudu.
learn.title: Why wudu?

learn.en: Before you begin: wash off any dirt, make sure your clothes are clean, and use pure water.
learn.title: Getting ready

learn.en: Intention in your heart, say Bismillah, then wash your hands three times — right then left, between the fingers.
learn.title: Steps 1–3

learn.en: Rinse your mouth three times, sniff water into your nose and blow it out gently three times, then wash your face three times.
learn.title: Steps 4–6

learn.en: Wash your right arm to the elbow three times, then the left. Wipe your head once, then your ears.
learn.title: Steps 7–9

learn.en: Wash your feet three times, right foot first, between the toes. Then say the Shahadah.
learn.title: Steps 10–11
learn.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
learn.tr: Ash-hadu allā ilāha illa-llāh, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhū wa rasūluh

learn.en: There is no salah without wudu!
learn.title: Remember

words.en: 7. Wash the arms to the elbows ×3

order.en: Put the 11 steps of wudu in order

quiz.en: I always wash my ___ foot before my left one.
I rinse out my mouth ___ times.
I say Bismillah when I ___ wudu.
I wash my face ___ I wash my arms.
I give my nose a ___ blow.

think.q: Can you show Mum or Dad all 11 steps of wudu at the sink right now?
think.a: Great! Remember: right side first, three times each, and finish with the Shahadah.

parents.summary: Wudu in 11 steps: intention, Bismillah, hands, mouth, nose, face, arms, head, ears, feet, and the Shahadah.
parents.tip: Watch him make wudu once and gently check the order of the steps.
